subject: RE: FW: VIENNA AIRPORT - ATL / 149 CTN 765 KGS
body:
Dear Sir or Madam,

Could you please quote an all-in price in EUR for air freight from STR to SGN? The shipment will be ready on 2026-11-25, and we will deliver it to STR ourselves.

The shipment consists of 8 pieces of laboratory glassware, with a gross weight of 257 kg and a volume of 1.32 cbm.

The goods must arrive at SGN no later than 2026-11-29. Please confirm the scheduled arrival date for the service you quote. Among the options that meet this deadline, price will determine our choice.

Thank you for your help.

Kind regards
Anna Sonnberg
Head of Purchasing and Logistics
Sonnberg Kaffeeroesterei GmbH


-----Original Message-----
Sent: 2026-09-16
Subject: VIENNA AIRPORT - ATL / 149 CTN 765 KGS

Dear team,

pls quote air freight ex VIENNA AIRPORT to ATL:
149 CTN / 765 KGS / 15.3 CBM, machine parts
FCA, cargo ready next week.

Thanks

classification.reasoning: The customer is requesting an all-in air freight quote for a new shipment from STR to SGN.
